body.statement: In the standard no-latent special case \(\ell=0\), \(\gamma=\operatorname{Cov}(Z,T)/\operatorname{Var}(Z)\) and \(\beta=\{\operatorname{Cov}(T,Y)-\gamma\operatorname{Cov}(Z,Y)\}/\{\operatorname{Var}(T)-\gamma\operatorname{Cov}(Z,T)\}\) whenever the denominator is nonzero.
body.justification: The frontier must reduce to ordinary residualized linear identification when latent confounding is absent.
body.gap: This is a required sanity reduction, not a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It checks normalization and implementation against the familiar covariance formula.
